title: Romantic Date Night
desc: The classic West Chester date night: a cocktail, a serious dinner, and a show, all on foot.

steps.title: Cocktails at Avalon
steps.desc: Modern Italian with a proper bar at 116 E Gay St. Start with one drink; dinner is elsewhere.

steps.title: Dinner at Andiario
steps.desc: Seasonal pre-set dinner at 106 W Gay St, Wednesday to Saturday. It made the New York Times' 2022 list of the 50 restaurants they loved most. Reservations essential.

steps.title: Show at Uptown! Knauer
steps.desc: Theater, music or comedy at the restored performing arts center, 226 N High St.

title: Downtown Walking Tour
desc: Experience the best of downtown West Chester on foot. Coffee, shops, and a great lunch.

steps.title: Coffee at Roots Cafe
steps.desc: A good latte and a pastry at 133 E Gay St.

steps.title: Browse Gay Street Shops
steps.desc: Walk Gay Street and pop into the boutiques, vintage shops, and local stores.

steps.title: Lunch at Carlino's Market
steps.desc: Italian market and deli at 128 W Market St. Sandwiches, prepared foods, and imports to take home.

steps.title: Chester County History Center
steps.desc: An hour with Chester County's past at 225 N High St. Open Wednesday to Saturday, 10 to 4.

title: Brandywine Valley Art Day
desc: A day exploring the incredible art and gardens of the Brandywine Valley.

steps.title: Brandywine Museum of Art
steps.desc: The Wyeth collection and American illustration in a converted mill at 1 Hoffman's Mill Rd, Chadds Ford. Closed Tuesdays.

steps.title: Lunch at Terrain Cafe
steps.desc: Farm-to-table restaurant inside a garden center at 914 Baltimore Pike, Glen Mills. The setting is the point.

steps.title: Longwood Gardens
steps.desc: An afternoon in 1,100 acres of gardens and conservatories. The fountain shows run in season; check the calendar.

title: Craft Beer Afternoon
desc: Two of downtown's beer stops, a few blocks apart.

steps.title: Start at Artillery Brewing
steps.desc: Small-batch taproom at 333 Granite Alley, open Thursday to Sunday.

steps.title: Finish at Bierhaul Townhouse
steps.desc: German-style beer hall at 15 N Walnut St with pretzels, brats, and a biergarten upstairs.

title: Family Fun Day
desc: A full day of kid-friendly activities around West Chester.

steps.title: Everhart Park
steps.desc: Start with the playground, open fields, and walking paths. Pack some snacks.

steps.title: American Helicopter Museum
steps.desc: More than 35 helicopters and hands-on exhibits. Thursday to Saturday 10 to 5, Sunday 12 to 5. Rides happen only on occasional event days.

steps.title: Lunch at Más Mexicali Cantina
steps.desc: Family-friendly with good tacos and a kids' menu, 102 E Market St.

steps.title: West Chester Railroad
steps.desc: A 90-minute scenic ride from 230 E Market St. Book on the railroad's site; seasonal specials sell out.

title: Dog Walk & Brunch
desc: A perfect morning with your pup — trails, outdoor dining, and good vibes.

steps.title: Hike Stroud Preserve
steps.desc: 571 acres and more than nine miles of trail through meadow and woods. Dogs leashed at all times. Free, dawn to dusk.

steps.title: Brunch at Stove & Tap
steps.desc: Brunch at 158 W Gay St. The patio is dog-friendly.

title: Girls' Day Out
desc: Shopping, wine, and a great dinner — the perfect WC ladies' day.

steps.title: Downtown Boutique Shopping
steps.desc: Browse the unique boutiques along Gay Street and Church Street.

steps.title: Wine tasting at Chaddsford Winery
steps.desc: Tastings daily 11 to 5 in the 1800s bank barn at 632 Baltimore Pike, about 20 minutes south.

steps.title: Dinner at Mercato Ristorante and Bar
steps.desc: Handmade pasta and Italian wines at 33 W Market St.

title: History Buff Day
desc: Centuries of American history in one day: downtown, then the du Pont estates along the Brandywine. Plan it for Thursday through Saturday, when everything on the list is open.

steps.title: Chester County History Center
steps.desc: Start downtown at 225 N High St. Open Wednesday to Saturday, 10 to 4.

steps.title: Lunch at Pietro's Prime
steps.desc: Classic steakhouse lunch in a beautifully restored historic building.

steps.title: Hagley Museum
steps.desc: The original du Pont gunpowder works, workers' village and family estate at 200 Hagley Creek Rd, Wilmington. Closed Wednesdays.

steps.title: Winterthur Estate
steps.desc: The premier American decorative arts collection and 1,000 acres of garden, 5105 Kennett Pike, Winterthur. Closed Mondays.

title: College Town Night Out
desc: Experience the WCU college-town energy with affordable eats and fun bars.

steps.title: Tacos at Más Mexicali Cantina
steps.desc: Lively and affordable at 102 E Market St.

steps.title: Drinks at Kildare's
steps.desc: Classic Irish pub at 18 W Gay St with live music and a patio.

steps.title: Late Night at Side Bar
steps.desc: Good music, good drinks, and a lively late-night crowd.
